The exact value of $\frac{d}{dx}\left(p \frac{du}{dx}\right) = p u'' + p' u'$.

$\text{TE} = \frac{h_i - h_{i-1}}{3} p_i u_i''' + \text{higher order}$

## Setting Up the Expansion

**Expanding $u$ around $x_i$:**
$$\frac{u_{i+1}-u_i}{h_i} = u_i' + \frac{h_i}{2}u_i'' + \frac{h_i^2}{6}u_i''' + \cdots$$
$$\frac{u_i-u_{i-1}}{h_{i-1}} = u_i' - \frac{h_{i-1}}{2}u_i'' + \frac{h_{i-1}^2}{6}u_i''' - \cdots$$

**Expanding $p$ around $x_i$:**
$$p_{i+1/2} = p_i + \frac{h_i}{2}p_i' + \frac{h_i^2}{8}p_i'' + \cdots$$
$$p_{i-1/2} = p_i - \frac{h_{i-1}}{2}p_i' + \frac{h_{i-1}^2}{8}p_i'' - \cdots$$

## Computing the Truncation Error

Multiplying and subtracting, then collecting terms:

$$T = p_{i+1/2}\frac{u_{i+1}-u_i}{h_i} - p_{i-1/2}\frac{u_i-u_{i-1}}{h_{i-1}}$$

$$T = \frac{p_i u_i''}{2}(h_i+h_{i-1}) + \frac{p_i' u_i'}{2}(h_i+h_{i-1}) + \frac{p_i u_i'''}{6}(h_i^2-h_{i-1}^2) + \cdots$$

Dividing by $h_i^* = \frac{1}{2}(h_i+h_{i-1})$:

$$\frac{T}{h_i^*} = (p_i u_i'' + p_i' u_i') + \frac{h_i^2-h_{i-1}^2}{3(h_i+h_{i-1})}p_i u_i''' + \cdots$$

Since $\frac{h_i^2-h_{i-1}^2}{h_i+h_{i-1}} = h_i - h_{i-1}$:

$$\frac{T}{h_i^*} = (pu''+p'u')\Big|_{x_i} + \frac{h_i-h_{i-1}}{3}\,p_i u_i''' + \mathcal{O}(h^2)$$

## Conclusion

The exact operator is $\frac{d}{dx}(p\,u') = pu'' + p'u'$, so:

$$\text{Truncation Error} = \frac{h_i - h_{i-1}}{3}\,p_i u_i''' + \mathcal{O}(h^2)$$

When $h_i \neq h_{i-1}$, the leading-order error is linear in the mesh-size difference, degrading the scheme from second-order (on uniform grids) to **first-order** in $h$.
